z-m-34-13.title: K-ga laba xariiq isbarbar ay yihiin: labadaba 2 iyo −2?
z-m-34-13.topic: Isla'egyada qaababka: shuruudda laba xariiq ay isbarbar yihiin, iyo is waafaqidda (xariiqyo xaraf ku jira)
z-m-34-13.goal: Hubi haddii dhammaan k laga helay shuruudda jiilaalka le'eg oo keliya ay runtii bixiyaan xariiqyo isbarbar ah, kala saar xaaladaha is waafaqa, oo sharax in jawaabtu ku xiran karto qeexidda isbarbar.
z-m-34-13.material: Waxaa jira xariiq l₁: kx + 2y = 4 iyo xariiq l₂: 2x + ky = 4 (k waa tiro dhab ah). Hawshan, 'isbarbar' macnaheedu waa laba xariiq oo kala duwan oo aan kulmin, haddii labada isla'eg ay yihiin isla xariiq, waxay 'is waafaqaan' mana aha isbarbar. Harin wuxuu helay qiyamka k ee labada xariiq ay isbarbar yihiin sida hoose. (Lambarrada sadarrada waxay ka bilaabmaan 1.)

z-m-34-02.s.s1.r.b: Masaafada laga bilaabo asalka ilaa P waxaa laga heli karaa isku-dubbaridka oo keliya. Way hore tahay in la yiraahdo macluumaadku ma ku filna.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.o.c: 2: P waa goobada ka baxsan, sidaas darteed mid dhinac kasta ayaa laga sawiri karaa
z-m-34-02.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad saadaalisay tirada taabteyaasha adigoo ka bilaabaya booska dhibicda. Tani waxay noqotaa halbeegga is barbar dhigidda natiijada xalka.
z-m-34-02.s.s1.o.d: Aan dhammaad lahayn: qaar ka mid ah xariiqyada laga sawiray P ilaa goobada had iyo jeer waa taabteyaal
z-m-34-02.s.s1.r.d: Xariiq taabte waa xariiq taabata goobada hal dhibic oo keliya. Ka fikir sawir imisa xariiq oo sidaas ah ayaa jira.

z-m-34-02.s.s2.prompt: Dooro hal sadar xalka Jiho ah oo leh dhibaato. (Waxaa jiri kara in ka badan hal sadar oo dhibaato leh.)
z-m-34-02.s.s2.hint.0: Hubi haddii sadar kasta si sax ah uga yimaado sadarka ka hor, sadarrada aan xisaab ahayn-na ka fikir haddii malo-awaalka ama gabagabada ay sheegaan had iyo jeer sax yihiin.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii isla'egta xariiqda xalku isticmaalo ay matali karto xariiq kasta oo marta dhibicda P.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.line.0: Haddii jiilaalka taabtuhu yahay m, taabtuhu waa y − 5 = m(x − 3).
z-m-34-02.s.s2.line.1: Masaafada laga bilaabo badhtamaha (0, 0) ee goobada ilaa xariiqdan waa inay le'eg tahay xarigga 3, sidaas darteed |5 − 3m| / √(m² + 1) = 3.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.line.2: Labajibbaarida labada dhinac iyo fududaynta waxay bixisaa 25 − 30m + 9m² = 9m² + 9, sidaas darteed m = 8/15.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.line.3: Sidaas darteed taabtuhu waa y − 5 = (8/15)(x − 3) oo keliya.
z-m-34-02.s.s2.explain: Sadarka 1 wuxuu u qaatay taabtaha inuu leeyahay jiilaal, sadarka 4-na waa gabagabada 'hal oo keliya' ee ka timid malo-awaalkaas. Xisaabta (sadarrada 2 iyo 3) waa sax. Xariiq aan jiilaal lahayn (xariiq isbarbar ah dhidibka y) lagama qori karo qaabka y − 5 = m(x − 3), sidaas darteed waa laga reebay xalka.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.prompt: Qor sababta hal taabte oo keliya u soo baxday iyo isla'egta taabtaha maqan, oo qor hal hab oo lagu hubiyo in xariiqdu runtii tahay taabte.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ka fikir xariiq isla'egta Jiho aysan matali karin qiime kasta oo m ah.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.hint.1: Si toos ah u cabbir masaafada laga bilaabo asalka ilaa xariiqdaas.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma helay oo qoray isla'egta xariiqda maqan adigu?
z-m-34-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma runtii hubiyay inay tahay taabte adigoo habka aan qoray isticmaalaya?
z-m-34-02.s.s3.model.0: Haddii aad jiilaalka dhigto m, xariiq taagan lama muujin karo, sidaas darteed waa laga reebay. Midda hadhay waa x = 3, masaafada laga bilaabo asalka ilaa xariiqdanna waa 3, oo le'eg xarigga, sidaas darteed waa taabte.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.model.1: Xariiqda x = 3, oo isbarbar ah dhidibka y, jiilaal ma laha, sidaas darteed isla'egta kama soo baxday. Dhigidda x = 3 goobada x² + y² = 9 sii, waxay ku kulmaan hal dhibic oo keliya (3, 0), sidaas darteed waa taabte.
z-m-34-02.s.s3.model.2: Isla'egta leh jiilaal m ma matali karto xariiq toosan dhidibka x, sidaas darteed hal xariiq oo taabte ah ayaa la seegay. Midda maqan waa x=3, maadaama masaafada laga bilaabo asalka ilaa xariiqdan ay tahay 3, waa xariiq taabte.

z-m-34-04.title: Haddii wadarka labajibbaarrada masaafooyinka ilaa laba bar uu joogto yahay, shax noocee ah ayaa soo baxa?
z-m-34-04.topic: Isla'egaha shaxanka: goobta baraha wadarka labajibbaarrada masaafooyinkoodu ilaa laba bar joogto yahay
z-m-34-04.goal: Isla'eg ku hubi qiyaas laga sameeyey dhowr bar, oo ku habee, iyo shuruudaha, sida urur baraha uga beddelmo wareeg ilaa hal bar ilaa bar la'aan marka joogtadu is beddesho.
z-m-34-04.material: Sagxadda isku-xidhka waxaa jira laba bar A(−2, 0), B(2, 0). Ka fikir ururka dhammaan baraha P(x, y) ee buuxiya PA² + PB² = k. (PA² waa labajibbaarka masaafada u dhexeysa barta P iyo barta A, taasi waa, masaafada u dhexeysa P iyo A oo la labajibbaaray, k na waa joogto go'an.)
z-m-34-04.thinking.2: Sheegidda shuruudaha gunaanadka marka joogtada is beddesho
z-m-34-04.s.s1.prompt: Xogta hal-hal ayaa loo muujiyaa. Mar kasta, dooro fikirkaaga ku saabsan shaxda ururka baraha leeyahay.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tallaabo kasta, kala saar waxa ka beddelmay tallaabadii hore iyo waxa isku mid ahaa.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.hint.1: Si aad u hubiso haddii shaxda aad dooratay sax tahay, dooro hal bar oo naftaada xisaabi PA² iyo PB².
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Waxaad dejisay k = 16 oo waxaad tijaabisay dhowr bar. P(2, 0), P(0, 2), P(−2, 0) dhammaantood waxay buuxiyaan PA² + PB² = 16.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Shax noocee ah ayaad u malaysaa dhammaan baraha buuxiya shuruudda inay sameeyaan?
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Saddexda bar waxay ku yaalaan wareeg leh xarun asalka iyo qotoda dhexe 2. Laakiin saddex bar oo keliya ma xaqiijin karaan 'waa wareeg', waana ku habboon tahay in lagu hayo sida qiyaas.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Saddexda bar dhammaantood waxay ka fog yihiin asalka masaafo 2, sidaa darteed waxay u egtahay wareeg. Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan sidoo kale hubiyo baro badan
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kani waa qiyaas fiican oo furan ka dhigaysa sida xukunkaagu u beddeli karo marka baruhu badan yihiin.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Isbarbar dhig isku-xidhyada saddexda bar. Waad hubin kartaa haddii ay hal xariijin ku yaalaan.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Saddexdan bar waa dhammaan. Bar kale ma jiraan
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Xisaabi haddii bar kale, tusaale ahaan (0, −2), buuxiso shuruudda.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Hubaal waa wareeg, sidaa darteed looma baahna in dheeraad la hubiyo
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ma hubin kartid inay tahay wareeg saddex bar oo keliya. Waxaa jira shaxo badan oo maraya saddexda bar.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ha noqdo barta P(x, y) oo ku qor isku-xidhyada, PA² = (x + 2)² + y² iyo PB² = (x − 2)² + y². Isku darka iyo fududaynta waxay siinaysaa 2x² + 2y² + 8 = k.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Marka k = 16, shax noocee ah ayaa dhammaan baraha buuxiya shuruudda sameeyaan?
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Haddii 2x² + 2y² + 8 = 16, markaas x² + y² = 4. Qiyaastii ugu horreysay (wareeg) waxaa xaqiijiyey isla'egta, qotoda dhexena waa 2. Tani waa xaalad aad qiyaasta ku ilaalin karto sida ay tahay.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Wareeg leh xarun asalka iyo qotoda dhexe 4
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Xisaabi waa maxay qiimaha x² + y², oo hubi haddii qiimahaasi yahay labajibbaarka qotoda dhexe mise qotoda dhexe.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Wareeg leh xarun asalka iyo qotoda dhexe 2
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Qiyaasta waxaa xaqiijiyey isla'egta. Gunaanadkani wuxuu ka yimid xisaabinta in labajibbaarka qotoda dhexe uu yahay 4.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Baraha isla masaafo ka fog A iyo B, taasi waa, dhidibka y
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Shuruuddu maaha PA = PB, laakiin in PA² + PB² uu joogto yahay.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Wareeg leh xarun asalka iyo qotoda dhexe 8
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Marka 2x² + 2y² + 8 = 16 loo qaybiyo 2, hubi haddii aad sidoo kale maamushay 8.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Fududaynta waxay siinaysaa x² + y² = (k − 8)/2. Hadda beddel k oo eeg xaaladaha k = 8 iyo k = 4.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Marka k = 8 iyo marka k = 4, maxaa ku dhaca baraha buuxiya shuruudda?
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Haddii k = 8, markaas x² + y² = 0, sidaa darteed waxaa jira asalka oo keliya, haddii k = 4 na, x² + y² = −2, sidaa darteed bar ma buuxiso. Waa wareeg marka k > 8 oo keliya. z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Marka k yaraado, wareegga sidoo kale wuu yaraadaa: haddii k = 8 qotoda dhexe waa 2, haddii k = 4 na qotoda dhexe waa 1
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Xisaabi waxa aad hesho marka aad geliso k = 8 (k − 8)/2.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Wareeg ayaa la sameeyaa k kasta, k = 4 na waa wareeg leh qotoda dhexe taban
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Qotoda dhexe waa masaafo, sidaa darteed ma noqon karto taban. Ka fikir haddii ay jirto bar buuxisa x² + y² = (tiro taban).
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Haddii k = 8 waa hal bar oo keliya, asalka, haddii k = 4 na bar noocaas ah gabi ahaanba ma jirto
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waxaad go'aamisay tirada baraha adigoo ka fikiraya goorta x² + y² uu yahay 0 ama taban.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Haddii k = 8 bar noocaas ah ma jirto, haddii k = 4 na waa hal bar, asalka
z-m-34-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Hubi haddii qiimaha aad hesho marka aad geliso k = 8 iyo k = 4 (k − 8)/2 uu yahay 0 ama taban.
z-m-34-04.s.s1.reflect: Maxaa ku dhacay qiyaastii aad ka sameysay saddexdii bar ee ugu horreysay ka dib marka aad ku hubisay isla'eg? Marka k is beddesho, qaybta gunaanadka kee ayaa lagu hagaajiyey shuruud la darayo?
z-m-34-04.s.s2.prompt: Qor sida urur baraha P u beddelmo iyadoo ku xidhan qiimaha k. (Ku dar qiimayaasha k ee uu ku beddelmo.)
z-m-34-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kala saar xaaladaha qiimaha dhinaca midig ee x² + y² = (k − 8)/2 uu yahay togan, 0, iyo taban.

z-m-34-04.s.s2.model.0: Haddii k ka weyn yahay 8, waa wareeg leh xarunta asalka, haddii k = 8 waa hal bar oo keliya, asalka, haddii k ka yar yahay 8 na bar buuxisa shuruudda ma jirto.
